moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio drag-inertia, written here): Knob 36x36 r8 in a 264x52 pill track (stops at both ends). Cursor grabs 0.35 s (knob scale 1.06 while held); 0.45-0.65 s dragged 60 px right (power2.in); released, it glides x = 117 × (1 − e^(−7.67 t)) (= speed × 0.88 per 60 fps frame), at rest by about 1.85 s. While moving scaleX = 1 + min(0.14, speed / 6000 px/s), scaleY inverse; velocity ticks trail below. Mirror throw back 1.85-3.3 s landing exactly on the start. Params: drag (60 px, 0.2 s) · glide (117 px) · decay (0.88 / khung 60 fps) · stretch (tối đa 1.14) · held (1.06).
